verdict.rationale: Riveter offers basic run tracking: webhooks fire on run.completed, run.stopped and run.finished, and the SDK can list runs filtered by status. However, there is no documented performance monitoring, no data-quality validation (dry_run only validates the request and estimates credits), and no failure-specific alerting. Missing for 10: job performance metrics/dashboards, output data-quality validation or checks, explicit failure alerts/notifications, independent corroboration.
